_doc: Escenarios: BACKGROUND (fondo de combate de lado) y MAP (región explorable entera, una sola imagen maestra que luego se recorta). SCENE: una escena explorable (aldea, caserío) vista desde arriba, a escala de personaje: un solo cuadro por el que el héroe pasea.

background.subject: a side-view battle stage background showing {name}{details}
background.pose: wide side-scrolling composition, the location seen from the side; a clear, mostly open walkable ground band across the lower third (where two fighters will stand facing each other, one on the left and one on the right); the visual interest is in the middle and far layers behind
mandatory: No characters, people, creatures or enemies anywhere.
No HUD, interface, text, frames or borders.
Leave the left third and the right third of the lower ground band uncluttered for the fighters.
It is a background stage, not a map: side view, not top-down.

map.subject: one single continuous overworld map of a region called {name}{details}
map.pose: top-down 3/4 classic 16-bit RPG world map view of the WHOLE region in one image
mandatory: ONE continuous, geographically coherent region, NOT a collage, NOT separate panels, NO grid, NO tiles, NO borders between areas.
Roads and paths connect the points of interest; rivers flow continuously; terrain transitions are gradual.
Every area shares the same scale, perspective, palette and lighting.
No text, labels, legend, compass, UI or frame.
Place each point of interest in the region of the image indicated in the layout, with open space around it.
map.layout_doc: Las zonas del mapa se colocan en una rejilla de 3×3 (norte/centro/sur × oeste/centro/este). El prompt pide cada punto de interés en su casilla y el MAP CUTTER recorta exactamente esas casillas (con margen) del mapa maestro: nunca se vuelve a generar nada.

scene.subject: one single explorable top-down RPG location: {name}{details}
scene.pose: elevated top-down 3/4 view of the WHOLE location in one image, at walking scale (buildings large enough that a small character could stand at each door), the place fills the frame edge to edge
mandatory: ONE continuous place, NOT a collage, NOT separate panels, NO grid, NO tiles.

WALKABLE ROADS ARE THE PRIORITY: one network of light sandy-brown dirt roads about one cart wide (not huge empty plazas), clearly lighter than the grass, continuous and unbroken, with a visible branch of road reaching the front door of EVERY building and every exit. No road is hidden under roofs, trees, crates or stalls.
In front of every building door there is a small open patch of bare dirt road (no props on it) where a character could stand.
Roads that leave the place run all the way to the edge of the image.
Every building has the same scale, perspective, palette and lighting; roofs do not cover the roads.
Empty of life: NO people, NO villagers, NO animals, NO creatures, NO characters at all.
No text, signs with letters, labels, legend, compass, UI, markers or frame.
Place each building in the area of the image indicated in the layout.
